descricao_original: The plasma cells in this image display a prominent pale staining area next to their nuclei. This region, referred to as a “negative Golgi”, results from the displacement of the abundant, basophilically-stained rough endoplasmic reticulum around it. Plasma cells secrete antibodies. 1000x
